descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S03 「现成的 spec：医院的任务审查有 Copy Text、没有 email 路径；Copy Text 生成器绝不合并同名病人，也绝不打出缺的房间」 Existing specs: Hospital task review has Copy Text and no email path; the Copy Text builder never merges same-name patients and never prints a missing room

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U9 'Email Tasks' is absent from the task screen: the button and the functionality, not just unused（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 11） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U3 Copy Text copies the whole list (pending and completed) to the clipboard in the same grouping, every task under its patient; the copy stays on the device（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U2 On the view the list is grouped by patient, pending tasks first and completed tasks at the bottom; every task shows which patient it belongs to（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U1 One consolidated in-app end-of-day view lists every open task across all of the physician's patients, each attributed to its patient（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home（UAT TC-07；UAT 3.3；TFA-92585 AC 12） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given task-export.spec.ts: two Hospital patients both named 'Task Probe Alpha' (rooms 31 and 32), one open task each. api/tasks-export.spec.ts: task groups for 'Ada Lovelace' (Room 12) and 'Grace Hopper' (no room); two 'J. Smith' patients in rooms 3 and 9

When Open /rounding/tasks, tap Copy Text, read the clipboard; build the Copy Text output from the fixtures

Then Heading 'Pending Tasks'; no button named Email and no mailto link; both rooms and both tasks shown; the clipboard has each patient heading with its own task; each heading carries only its own tasks; a patient without a room has no location; the two J. Smith patients are two groups; no 'undefined'

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions (the only lane that reads the real clipboard today). Evidence for U9 (Hospital) and for the pending part of U2/U3 on the screen and in the builder; no completed task is involved, so they say nothing about 'completed at the bottom' or AC 4's 'whole list' (S01, S02). A failure names the failing test, so screen and builder can be told apart

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S03 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-07.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
